tagline: Making affordable, high-performance national security solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Record order backlog is the primary growth indicator in the defense sector, reflecting sustained demand for drones, hypersonic systems, and C5ISR.

kpis.name: Order Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of signed contracts not yet delivered.
kpis.description: Backlog reflects future revenue visibility, up due to strategic contracts with DoW and major integrators.
kpis.signal: Backlog at record levels, supported by hypersonic and drone programs.

kpis.name: Capacity Investments
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for new facilities and production capacity.
kpis.description: Kratos is investing heavily in internal capacity for jet drones (Valkyrie), engines, microwave electronics, and hypersonic systems.
kpis.signal: Capex rising sharply to meet drone and hypersonic systems demand.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenues are predominantly from the U.S. government, with strong exposure to defense modernization programs.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by drone and C5ISR programs.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Margin after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin is improving progressively with higher volumes and production chain optimization.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin advancing slowly despite increased R&D and CAPEX investments.

kpis.name: R&D as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Kratos funds a significant portion of R&D internally to accelerate development of key products.
kpis.signal: Internal R&D supported for rapid innovation.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount growing to support ramp-up of hypersonic, drone, and defense electronics programs.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of EUR 2.47 billion in latest year

kpis.name: U.S. Government Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue from U.S. government.
kpis.description: Kratos relies heavily on federal contracts. In fiscal 2025, 68% of revenue came from the U.S. government (including all military branches and FMS), versus 67% in 2024 and 69% in 2023. This exposure creates dependence on federal budget cycles.
kpis.signal: High and stable exposure to U.S. defense budgets.

kpis.name: Hypersonic Systems Investments
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to hypersonic programs (Zeus, Erinyes).
kpis.description: Kratos is developing core capabilities for hypersonic missiles, a strategic priority for DoW. Investments include a hypersonic integration factory in Indiana for Zeus SRM and Erinyes, plus long lead item procurement.
